_how: The only file to edit. Then run: node hub/build.mjs && node hub/check.mjs
status: three lists of short lines. An empty list shows as 'Nothing.' A line is plain text, or { text, href } to make it a link (href: a site path, or #play, #sound, #looks, #docs).
sections > groups > links. Every href and thumb is relative to the site root (hub/site/).
link fields: title, href, see (one line: what you will see). Optional: keys, thumb, also, from.
keys: lines like 'W, S, A, D: paddle and walk'. Keys before the colon, comma-separated.
thumb: a picture in shots/. The build makes game-<name>.jpg and look-<a|b|b2|c>-<name>.jpg.
also: extra small links under a thumbnail, each with title and href.
from: a markdown file (path from the portage folder). The build renders it to the href, which must be docs/<name>.html.
name: Portage
pitch: A browser survival-crafting game. The valley flooded. You have a leaky canoe, and you bolt what you build onto it.

done: Rules engine. Runs with no screen. 179 tests pass. A bot finishes the whole main quest.
Playable game with sound, first in placeholder graphics (greybox).
Three art looks built and reviewed. A Cutbank 50, B Ink & Wash 50, C Blue Hour 45, each out of 60. The reviewer picks B.
B2 built: look B drawn at the screen's full size, with clean pen lines and more drawn detail. Same menus, lobby and HUD.
Luc picked B2 on 2026-11-11. The game gets built in that look.

Step 1 of 3: the real game now draws in B2, with the Ink & Wash lobby, menus and HUD on real game data. 477 tests pass, plus 31 browser tests that press real keys. The bot finishes the main quest in the new look.
The player, the crew and the canoe stay sharp at every zoom and window size, and picture quality climbs back after a slow spell. Luc had seen the player go blurry when zooming out.
The rules handle up to 4 players sharing one canoe, and tools belong to the whole crew. Solo plays the identical game. F is the action key, the lantern is on L, scavenging takes one press.
Item icons: a drawn icon beside every item name, 54 in all.

The crew is drawn properly: each player in their own seat and their own colours, paddling, bailing, sleeping and walking for themselves. A far-away player keeps a fine outline. 629 tests pass, plus 58 browser tests.
Live on the web at https://sigouin.net/portage/ . Anyone with the link can play; search engines are asked not to list it.
The canoe: four hull tiers you can tell apart, all 19 attachments drawn for this hull, and the three survivors as their own figures.
The valley: every landmark and scavenge node drawn, all 15 islands told apart by outline, 21% fewer triangles.
The HUD has a crew: a crew list with each player's colour, place and meters, crewmates on the compass and the map, notes for the whole crew, reward icons in the quest log.
Weather and night: rain, storm, fog, stars, light from the lantern, the campfire and the Beacon, and the sky showing what is coming. Nothing flashes.
Co-op groundwork: players who drop and come back, a host and guests kept in step, two tabs on one computer playing one game. 815 tests pass, plus 86 browser tests.
Weather, night and the co-op groundwork are live on sigouin.net/portage (fourth deploy, commit 0d3a8fd). Two tabs played one game on the live site.
The workbench is public at sigouin.net/portage/workbench, for a phone anywhere. The reports and the hub stay on the home network.
Why it was choppy on a slower computer, measured. A one-link report a friend can run (?perf=1).
Smooth on slower computers: the game times the chip at load, two lower quality steps, even drawing on 75, 90 and 144 Hz screens.
Loose ends fixed in the valley, the weather and the canoe. A balance pass. A quest that could strand you is fixed for all 21 quests.
Friends join by a link: a relay, Host a crew and Join a crew in the lobby, and a guest whose walking answers at once. Proven on this Mac only. Not deployed.
The asset viewer: every drawn thing alone, on a grid. Live at https://sigouin.net/portage-assets/ .
A fresh scored review: look 8, speed 8, friends 8, first minutes 7, canoe 7, solid 6. 1098 tests pass, plus 118 browser tests.
The fix round: ten fixes from the review, each with a test seen red. 1129 tests pass, plus 119 browser tests. Old saves from the live game are tested on every build.
Live on Nov 12: everything built that day, at https://sigouin.net/portage/ . Friends by a link stays off until the relay is deployed.

A faster canoe: paddle 3.2 m/s (was 2.2), power stroke 4.2 (was 3.2), with rough water raised by the same share. Doubling was tried first and broke the sail and the rough-water gates. 1131 unit tests pass. No browser pass on it yet: Luc tests it.

waiting.text: The workbench: every step so far, in point form. Made for your phone.
The review: six scores and sixteen fixes, worst first.

waiting: Luc: six calls from the review. Build payoff, the first hull upgrade, trees hiding the player, the relay rate limit, crafts made early, steady 30 on very slow chips.
Luc: the relay needs your go and a small Cloudflare service before friends can join over the internet.

waiting.text: Luc: the starting canoe is weathered grey, not red. Keep or bring the red back?

waiting: Luc: the game is live with the Nov 12 work. Your old save continues. Play it and say what feels wrong.
Luc: Claude Code broke twice today (a reinstall without its last step). New workers cannot start while it is broken.
Next: score the three low points again, then the slow-chip start and one shaky speed test.

sections.title: Play
sections.note: The real game in the B2 look, with the Ink & Wash menus and HUD. Rules, quests and sound are in. Still simple stand-ins until step 2: landmarks (steeple, pylons, bridge), the three survivors and three attachments. Storm marks and lantern light come in step 3. Needs a keyboard and mouse: no phone controls yet.
